Technology stocks were underwater on Thursday, with shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing 1.7% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was falling 2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Zscaler ( ZS ) jumped 13% in the wake of financial results issued after the close Tuesday that exceeded Wall Street expectations. US stock markets were closed Wednesday.
In other sector news:
(+) Okta ( OKTA ) climbed 13% on Thursday after the identification-technology company cruised past analyst projections with its Q3 financial results.
(-) Momo ( MOMO ) retreated Thursday, sinking 15%, after the Chinese mobile social and entertainment platform company reported adjusted earnings that met Wall Street expectations. while sales came in slightly above expectations.
